zh: 总时长可能达到 10⁹ 小时，不能逐小时模拟；要直接算出每个订单的完成时刻再相加。
订单 i 完成前先经过 T[i]−1 整轮，这期间每个订单 j 消耗 min(T[j],T[i]−1) 小时；最后一轮里，排在 i 前面（含 i）且 T[j]≥T[i] 的订单各再消耗 1 小时。
把 T 排序并求前缀和，二分找到小于 T[i] 的订单数 split，第一部分为 前缀和[split]+(N−split)×(T[i]−1)。按下标顺序处理，用树状数组记录已处理订单的 T 值，第二部分为 i+1 减去其中 T 小于 T[i] 的个数。两部分相加得到完成时刻，累加后对 10⁹ 取模输出，累加过程用 64 位整数。
en: The total time can reach 10⁹ hours, so simulating hour by hour is too slow; compute each order's completion time directly and add them up.
Before order i finishes, T[i]−1 full rounds pass, during which every order j uses min(T[j],T[i]−1) hours; in the final round, each order at or before i with T[j]≥T[i] uses one more hour.

Sort T and take prefix sums; binary search the number split of orders with T less than T[i], so the first part is prefix[split]+(N−split)×(T[i]−1). Process orders by index with a Fenwick tree over the T values seen so far; the second part is i+1 minus how many of them have T less than T[i]. Their sum is the completion time; add these up in 64-bit integers and print the total mod 10⁹.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Before order i is finished, T[i]−1 full rounds pass in total, contributing Σmin(T[j],T[i]−1), plus the number of still unfinished orders before i in the final round. Sorted prefix sums give the first term and a Fenwick tree counts the second.

## Proof of correctness

In the first T[i]−1 rounds each order consumes exactly min(T[j],T[i]−1) hours; in the final round the original order is unchanged, and only orders with index ≤ i and T[j] ≥ T[i] are processed. These two parts neither overlap nor miss anything, and summing the completion times gives the total waiting time.

## Complexity

Time O(N log N+N log V), space O(N+V), where V≤10000.
